notes: The per-day attendance charts on the admin hub now read Sundays properly. A Sunday nobody logged into is labelled down the plot instead of being drawn as a bar of zero, so a closed day no longer looks like a catastrophic one; a Sunday somebody did work keeps its bar and is captioned as Sunday working. In Employee Khata, admin logins are no longer mixed into the list of employees when picking somebody — they are held back until you search for them by name, and the picker says how many are hidden.
